entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Shyam Singh Sengar Hon'ble Saumitra Dayal Singh,J.
1.

Heard Sri Pradeep Singh Sisodia, learned counsel for the applicants, learned A.G.A. for the State and, Sri Shyam Singh Sengar, learned counsel for the opposite party No. 2.
2.

On 8.12.2022, below quoted order has been passed:
"Sri Shyam Singh Sengar, Advocate has filed his Vakalatnama on behalf of opposite party No.2, the same is taken on record.

Heard Sri Pradeep Singh Sisodia, learned counsel for applicant, learned AGA for the State and Sri Shyam Singh Sengar, learned counsel for opposite party No.2.
Learned counsel for parties submits that the parties have entered into compromise and the same has been filed before the trial court.
It is a matrimonial dispute and the disptue has been amicably resolved outside the Court by way of compromise.

entities.text: Rashid And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 Learned counsel for applicants prays for and is granted a week's time to file supplementary affidavit bringing on record the compromise filed by the parties before the learned trial court.
List on 19.12.2022 as fresh.

On the next date of listing the name of Sri Shyam Singh Sengar shall be shown in the cause list as counsel for opposite party No.2."
3.
Today, supplementary affidavit has been filed.
By means of supplementary affidavit, written settlement reached between the parties dated 3.12.2022 has been brought on record.
At present, the parties have reconciled their differences such that they are living together in matrimony.
4. The above submissions advanced by learned counsel for the applicants have been supported by learned counsel for opposite party no.2.

5. In such circumstances, though no useful purpose would be served in allowing the prosecution to continue any further, however, no firm conclusion may be reached, at this stage, as to complete falsity of the allegations made against the applicants.
The present 482 Cr.P.C. application thus stands allowed.

6. Subject to the above, the charge-sheet dated 13.11.2022, cognizance order dated 19.04.2022 as well as entire proceedings of Criminal Case No. 3620 of 2022 (State vs Rashid & Ors.), arising out of Case Crime No. 0322 of 2021, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. & Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station- Mahila Thana, District - Muzaffar Nagar, pending in the court of Judicial Magistrate, Muzaffar Nagar, are quashed.
